title: A New Café in Town
text:
Maria wrote a review of a new café in her town. She said the coffee was very good and the cakes were fresh. The staff were friendly, but the café was small and often full.

Her review had three stars. She thought the prices were high, so she did not visit every day. However, she said she would come back for the cakes.

questions.text: How many stars did Maria give the café?
What can we infer about Maria's opinion of the café?
options: She had mixed feelings about it
She loved it without any doubts

questions.text: What will Maria probably do in the future?

vocabulary.definition: an opinion written about a product, place or service
kind and pleasant to other people
the amount of money you pay for things

paragraph_translations: Maria napisała recenzję nowej kawiarni w swoim mieście. Powiedziała, że kawa była bardzo dobra, a ciasta świeże. Personel był przyjazny, ale kawiarnia była mała i często pełna.
Jej recenzja miała trzy gwiazdki. Uważała, że ceny są wysokie, więc nie chodziła tam codziennie. Powiedziała jednak, że wróci po ciasta.
